title: Garmin Run Asia Series 2026 Indonesia Review: A Tech-Brand Race at BSD City
seo_title: Garmin Run Asia Series 2026 Indonesia Review | BSD
meta_description: Garmin Run Asia Series 2026 Indonesia review: September 20 at ICE BSD City -- a GPS-watch brand's race in Greater Jakarta's planned satellite township.
dek: Set for 20 September 2026 at Indonesia Convention Exhibition, BSD City, this leg of Garmin's regional running series brings GPS-watch brand backing to one of Greater Jakarta's largest planned communities.
verdict: The Garmin Run Asia Series' Indonesia leg carries an obvious appeal for tech-minded runners: Garmin is one of the best-known GPS running-watch brands, and a race under its name typically means data tracking, device demos, and a tech-savvy crowd. Three distances (21.1K/10K/5K) at the Indonesia Convention Exhibition center keep it broadly accessible. BSD City itself is a genuinely major planned township within Greater Jakarta, spanning some 6,000 hectares with roughly 500,000 residents -- purpose-built infrastructure that suits a large-scale branded event. Registration status isn't yet announced, so this is one to watch rather than book immediately.

sections.heading: A GPS-Watch Brand's Signature Race
paragraphs: The Indonesia leg of the Garmin Run Asia Series offers 21.1K, 10K and 5K distances at the Indonesia Convention Exhibition (ICE) in BSD City. [1] Garmin is one of the most recognised GPS sports-watch brands globally, and races bearing its name typically lean into that identity -- expect device demos, data-driven pacing features, and a crowd that skews toward gear-conscious runners.

sections.heading: BSD City: A Major Planned Township
paragraphs: BSD City -- formerly Bumi Serpong Damai -- is a planned community within Greater Jakarta, initiated in 1984 and developed primarily by Sinar Mas Land. [2] It spans roughly 6,000 hectares and is home to approximately 500,000 people, blending residential, commercial and recreational areas in what was originally rubber-plantation land in South Tangerang. That scale gives the race a purpose-built venue with modern road infrastructure, parking, and exhibition-centre facilities.

sections.heading: ICE as an Event Hub
paragraphs: The Indonesia Convention Exhibition center at BSD City is one of Greater Jakarta's largest MICE (meetings, incentives, conferences, exhibitions) venues, regularly hosting large-scale expos and events. [1] Using it as a race hub gives organisers ready-made staging, registration, and post-race amenity space -- a practical choice for a brand activation event of this kind.

sections.heading: Registration Not Yet Announced
paragraphs: As of this writing, registration status for this event has not been announced. [1] Given Garmin's brand reach, demand could move quickly once sign-ups open, so it's worth watching official channels closely rather than waiting for a general announcement.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: If a tech-brand-backed race with strong venue infrastructure in one of Greater Jakarta's major planned communities appeals -- especially if you're already invested in Garmin's running ecosystem -- the Indonesia leg on 20 September 2026 is worth tracking closely. Registration hasn't opened yet, so there's nothing to sign up for immediately.
